text: {"assertions":["A corrupted scaffold bug was discovered in cli/commands/init.py on March 10, 2026.","The bug only occurred with deeply nested inputs beyond six levels.","The bug could be reproduced by initializing into a directory that already has a lockfile.","The root cause was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation.","The bug manifested as a missing file in the generated tree.","The fix involved prefetching the relation in a single query (PR #1155 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1).","The fix improved throughput by 20 percent to 204 requests per second.","This work was in the same area of cli/commands/init.py as earlier corrupted scaffold issues."]}
